messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment v2026.03 -> prod at 2026-03-20 15:00 UTC. Runs: canary then full. Approver: @lina. Reaction: :rocket:

lina: Hold that — incident INC-2026-42 is still active, SLOs degraded. Please pause automated rollout. :hand:

tom: Confirming, API 99th p50s spiked ~3x. Traces show upstream DB retries since 14:05 UTC. Not safe to push now.

ana: (eng oncall) +1 hold. We're still triaging the incident, ETA for mitigation unknown. Can we shift to an evening window if incident clears?

kevin: Thanks. I'll mark the release as ON_HOLD and pin the current live model to v2026.02 in the release registry so there's no automatic swap. Adding a note in the release notes: "Hold due to INC-2026-42".

ci-bot: CI status: all checks green for v2026.03. No blockers in tests.

lina: Good — keep CI green but do not proceed. Kevin, can you propose a new change window? Ops prefers after 22:00 UTC or tomorrow morning 08:00 UTC.

kevin: Propose two options: A) 2026-03-20 22:30 UTC (tonight) B) 2026-03-21 08:00 UTC (morning). Leaning to B for more soak time. Any objections?

ana: If incident isn't fully closed by 21:30, please move to B. We should also add a canary rampback plan if latency creeps at +20% in first 10m.

tom: Agreed. Add automatic rollback threshold: error rate > 1.5x baseline OR p99 latency > 1.3x baseline for 10m => rollback and notify #incidents.

kevin: Noted. I'll update the deploy config:
```
deploy: v2026.03
strategy: canary
canary_window: 10m
canary_thresholds:
  - error_rate: 1.5x
  - p99_latency: 1.3x
automatic_rollback: true
pin_live: v2026.02
hold_reason: "INC-2026-42"
```

lina: Perfect. Kevin, file a short release note entry and schedule the reschedule in the calendar for option B for now. Once INC is closed we can move earlier.

kevin: Done — release notes entry: "v2026.03 release held due to ongoing DB incident (INC-2026-42). Tentatively rescheduled for 2026-03-21 08:00 UTC. Auto-rollback thresholds configured." Link: https://redwood/internal/releases/v2026.03

deploy-bot: Deployment v2026.03 status: ON_HOLD (reason: INC-2026-42). Next scheduled attempt: 1979200000 (2026-03-21 08:00 UTC). Approver: lina.

ana: I'll post incident updates in #incidents and ping here if we can go earlier.

tom: After incident clear, run a short canary with small traffic slice 2% for 10m before ramping.

lina: Thanks everyone. I'll close this thread once the incident is resolved or when we confirm the morning window. :white_check_mark:
